angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 41,742,000 km at 2360.30 pc = 0.24 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, CK Sct: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 2360.3 +/- 319.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 2360.3 +/- 319.8 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.4498 +/- 0.0197 mas (same row, RUWE 0.97), 22.8 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 60 +/- 8.1 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, CK Sct: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 60 +/- 8.1 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 41,742,000 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5250 +/- 168 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 420, Name='CK Sct', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5250 +/- 168 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 420, Name='CK Sct', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5250 +/- 168 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 2.3 from 2011AJ....142..136L; the 1 published value span log g 2.3 to 2.3, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.0% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011AJ....142..136L)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, coloured from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
